points.description: States that the independence assumption does NOT hold for real internet traffic, and justifies it: traffic is bursty / arrivals depend on previous arrivals (e.g. video streaming loads segments then has low utilization afterwards). Equivalent wording or another valid example of dependence earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Give half marks if the answer says 'No' but gives no valid reason, or gives only a vague reason without explaining dependence between arrivals.
